column5: We never wish to disappoint, and so it is shameful that I must inform you that the clown is a bit imperfect tonight.
It was very distressing for us to find out that they have managed to lose their emotions.
However, dear audience, you need not worry! As there is a way for them to get their emotions back!
It will be a performance, a two act show. Throughout, they will be required to push themselves and attempt a terrible and punishing climb!
How foreboding! You will scare our dear audience too much like that! They will ascend towards the rafters covering the stage.
And! To ensure you have the best experience tonight, audience participation is not only welcomed, but expected!
Your first choice is whose trial to complete first.
